episodes.title: Blue Beetle
episodes.summary: The aftermath of a stolen cocaine shipment upends many lives in a small 1000 Islands town - from criminals to cops to comic book nerds.

episodes.title: Strange River
episodes.summary: Despite trying to cover his own tracks, things keep getting worse for Henry as Erica's investigation turns up more and more connections with Henry's past.

episodes.title: No Loose Ends
episodes.summary: A New York Kingpin sends his top brass to the 1000 Islands to track down the missing drugs, while Ruby and Miles, and the drugs everyone is after, go into hiding.

episodes.title: No Room at the No Tell Motel
episodes.summary: In the middle of the night, everyone finds themselves at The Heron Motel, where each room tells a different story of madness and mayhem.

episodes.title: Bones
episodes.summary: A series of flashbacks shed light on Henry and Tommy's mysterious dark history together while in present day, more secrets are uncovered. Nothing stays at the bottom of the river forever.

episodes.title: Long Time Running
episodes.summary: In the climactic conclusion, all of the secrets, lies and shady dealings finally come to a head, turning The Heron parking lot into an epic battlefield.
